论述总结: This deck presents SG-Filter, a similar-text-retrieval method. It reviews the mainstream retrieval paradigm and its limits on structured/summarized information, poses key questions on efficiently obtaining summarized semantics, proposes a hierarchical summarized-semantic index with adaptive filtering, then validates it on datasets and metrics with concluding effectiveness gains.
